title: Outdoor Grilled Dutch Banana Skewers
description: A mustardy and snappy Dutch dish featuring fried ripe bananas, double-fry KFC style, and low-carb friendly, all grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes before grilling.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, mustard, and paprika.
Heat the peanut oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dip each banana slice into the egg mixture, then coat in the flour mixture, and fry in the peanut oil until golden brown.
Remove the fried banana slices from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Thread 2-3 fried banana slices onto each wooden skewer.
Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the banana skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Serve the grilled banana skewers hot and enjoy.
